ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the bottom opening at the back?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a sagittal anatomical diagram of the human pelvis. At the back, the rectum can be seen extending downward, and the end of the rectum leads to an external opening at the back and lower part of the body. This opening is located behind and below the reproductive/urinary opening. Reasoning: The question asks “what is the bottom opening at the back,” not asking about a letter label. The external opening at the end of the rectum or digestive tract is anatomically called the anus.
